title: Tonight: sleeping spots, then beds
applies_when: Someone lacks a usable place to sleep.
approach: Sleeping spots cost no materials and appear immediately. Put temporary spots in the intended safe sleeping area while beds are built; they do not provide bed comfort.
Count existing and queued human sleeping capacity before adding furniture. Replace interim spots as beds become usable; do not build another full set because delivery is slow.
For colonist construction objectives require is_bed=true and bed_humanlike=true. Animal sleeping furniture is a separate need.
verify: Users, ownership, reachable sleeping cells, roof and temperature; a spot alone is not shelter.
reconsider: Capacity is already sufficient, or a joiner needs one additional place.
